import urllib.request
import json

# Check HGNC entry for HGNC:1954
url = "https://rest.genenames.org/fetch/hgnc_id/1954"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Accept': 'application/json'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
    data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    docs = data['response']['docs'][0]
    print("HGNC Symbol:", docs.get('symbol'))
    print("HGNC Name:", docs.get('name'))
    print("Previous symbols:", docs.get('prev_symbol'))
    print("Alias symbols:", docs.get('alias_symbol'))
